items.caption: This modern redraw presents an oracle-script form interpreted as a chicken pictograph, with a prominent head and crest. The form’s first reported use is as a place name, so its earliest referent is not certain.
items.alt: Black oracle-script character with a large oval head, crest-like strokes, and an elongated body with trailing strokes.
items.selection_reason: Visually legible and relevant to the proposed pictographic origin of 雞; the account associates early oracle forms with a chicken picture, while noting that the reported oracle use is a place name.

limitations.text: The image is a modern vector redraw, not an ancient inscription. The depicted form supports a pictographic interpretation, but the earliest use reported for the graph is as a place name and does not establish its original referent with certainty.

The two supplied candidates show identical pixels, and the second candidate is not a distinct seal-script glyph. The evidence identifies the Commons page as a modern redraw and only notes a linked seal-script version; it does not provide a separate image for that form.
